title: Entanglement governs early-time growth of randomness in projected ensembles
summary: Deep thermalization concerns the emergence of universal pure-state statistics in projected ensembles at late times, yet the mechanism governing the initial growth of randomness remains unclear. Here, we study the short-time dynamics of projected ensembles generated from initially unentangled states, quantifying their randomness using frame potentials.
